S.FORM: == kakiliman == miculu' u icelang nu aadupen singangan aca tu miculu'ay aadupen, kunuyanay miculu', u mikitaduay tu icelang nu aadupen miculu'. malecad tu micukaymasay tu icelang nu tademaw a miculu', u matenesay tu ku mahiniay u mipiculu'ay. ayaw u kikay dada' ku sapiculu' nu tademaw, tabaki ku nipaini nu aadupen tu tademaw. mikitadu ku tademaw tu aadupen pawapen tu cayay kalecad a kawaw, tinaku miculuay tu tademaw anca miculu' tu tuud, saculil atu pakatineng. mahiniay ku picukaymas nu tademaw, taneng kakelul mikacaw i uzip nu aadupen, u sapiedap aduku anca miecaw tu aadupen lunukay mikawaw. mapaecaw, pahabay mala u sapiculu' aadupen pangangan han kunuy aadupen, zuma angangan kacawanay nu tademaw nu mikunuyay aadupen hina mapangangan tu malu u kakacawen mueneng. zuma a tademaw amisungaay tu balucu' nu tau, mitengil tu nipiculcul nu tau, culculan, cayay paacaenay ku piedap a miculu' tu baketay a tuud, mahiza miecaw tu mala miculu'ay aadupen, i lalangawanay tu mahiniay a tademaw atu misungaay tu tau a wayway pangangan han tu "kunuyay aadupen" mikawaway aadupen "working animal" mikawaway aadupen miedapay mikawaw tu tademaw a lumaay aadupen atu nipahabayan aadupen, u pasu miculu'ay tu tuud nu mikakawaway aadupen "mahiniay low-tow, mikunuyay a subayu", u mitengtengay aadupen "mahiniay mitengtengay a subayu, malukay a katalalan, mitengtengay a wacu i suleda" atu pakatenengay tu kawaw a mikawaway aadupen "mahiniay mikawaway a wacu', patigamiay a banul, mikeliday tu mamenu'ay a subayu". mikawaway aadupen a lalekalan a likisi namakayzaay ayaw likisi a tademaw, tusu a kasazuma katalalan, subayu. 20 se-ci teban a mihcaan tu zikez, u katalalan, subayu u mikawaway aadupen mapakutay nu simal autubay. . misiwkay 簡介 tademaw micukaymas tu nipahabayay aadupen mumukuay tu baketay a anca mitengteng tu sakaluk a duku matenes tu mihcaan, ayaw nu si-yen 9000 a mihcaan, namapahabay ku aadupen hawsa, mala u mikutayay tu tademaw nu mimuku tu baketay a tuud. . tinaku katalalan nu Mey-su-pu-ta-mi-ya, Pey-o ay a nipahabayan a ngabul. u mitengtengay tu kazizeng aadupen ku mahiniay, nacaliway tu kalalacal, ayaw nu si-yen tu 2500 a mihcaan katukuh tu i In-tu, ayaw nu si-yen 1600 a mihcaan katukuh i Ay-ci, ayaw nu si-yen tu 1300 a mihcaan katukuh tu i Cong-kow, zuma, Ing-koway katukuh ayaw nu si-yen 500 a mihcaan kya malingatu mikawaw tu mahiniay a nalimaan. tademaw miculu'ay miculu' u icelang nu tademaw. malecad tu aadupen micukaymas tu aadupen miculu'ay, u matenesay tu ku mahiniay a piculu'. ayaw micukaymas tu kikay ku tademaw, uyni dada' u culu'. sakahenulan u mikawaway aadupen. naayaway a likisi atu Mey-su-pu-ta-mi-ya kanatal. subayu, u sapitengteng tu kazizeng anca salepacaw, mahiniay subayu kazizeng. li, adidi' ku nikan, micidekay a utubay atu icelang mikunuy. Iy-ci i ayaw nu si-yen 3000 a mihcaan micukaymas tu, Low, pikidamsayan tu li, subayu atu li malasheci ku kakatakis. wacu, mitengtenga' i suleda a wacu, wacu nu tayli, misebengay a wacu', mingaayay a wacu', miadupey a wacu' mikilimay a wacu', pahutinay a wacu' pazazanay tu mamenu'ay a wacu kahatini. zo, Nan-ya atu Tung-nan-ya kanatal, u sapilais ku zo atu miculu' i kilakilangan. damsayay a ngabul, u sienaway a kanatal. low-to, likelikenan a kanatal. ta-yang-to, Nan-mey talakaway buyu' a kanatal. nipahabanay a pabuy, taneng sapikilim tu sung-lu. nani', u mipatayay tu edu. yu, angangan u mung-yen-tyaw, u sapiadup. nipahabayan a banul, namapahabay mala u tigami a banul zikuz taneng u mibahelay nu patayzaay tu cudad a banul. makatalay nu mizakepay tu ayam, mahiniay cin-tyaw, li-ce-ing, yu-cin, hung-wi-kwang, u sapiadup tu palang. lu-ce, Tung-nan-ya a kitizaan, u sapibuting a lu-ce. 家鴿: . malalitin tu i hekalay tu zumaay a natinengan
